id: 14_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Risk Assessment and Hazard Mitigation Training C
title: 用电风险，先评估再动手（国内版）
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/14_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Risk Assessment and Hazard Mitigation Training C.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/14_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Risk Assessment and Hazard Mitigation Training C（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 电气风险可以按步骤评估
points.K3: 管理措施比单靠防护有效
points.K7: 规定要执行，不能放一边
points.K8: 接触电气设备的人都要培训
points.K9: 电气测试不戴金属饰物
points.K10: 规范管设计，也管干活的人
points.K12: 测试按标准，电弧要评估
points.S4: 自制改装用电装置先评估

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，手里拿着一张空白评估表，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by a lab bench holding a blank assessment sheet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：用电风险，先评估再动手。
overlay: 用电风险，先评估再动手

shots.scene: 阿杰抱来一台旧的大功率加热设备，准备接上插线板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries an old high-power heating device to the bench and reaches for a power strip.
shots.narration: 阿杰找来一台旧加热设备，想马上用。

shots.scene: 老周拦住他，递过一张空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The older man stops him and hands him a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 老周说：先把风险评估做了。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark above him, holding the blank form.
shots.narration: 评估？从哪儿下手呢？

shots.section_title: 电气风险可以按步骤评估
shots.scene: 放大镜照着设备、电线和插座
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon moving over an instrument, its power cord and a wall outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 用电的风险，可以按步骤评估。
overlay: 电气风险可以按步骤评估

shots.section_title: 电气风险可以按步骤评估
shots.scene: 危害图标和天平图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon next to a balance scale icon weighing likelihood and harm. No people.
shots.narration: 找出潜在危害，估计可能发生的风险。

shots.scene: 阶梯第一级：放大镜找到闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Step one on a staircase diagram: a magnifying glass finding a lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，找出这项工作有哪些电气危害。

shots.scene: 阶梯第二级：空白任务卡和扳手
shots.prompt_en: Step two on the staircase: a blank task card with a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，说清要做的是什么电气工作。

shots.scene: 阶梯第三级：从轻到重的伤害刻度
shots.prompt_en: Step three on the staircase: a severity scale from a small bandage to a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，估计一旦出事伤得多重。

shots.scene: 阶梯第四级：断线、老化、误操作图标指向触电
shots.prompt_en: Step four on the staircase: icons of a broken wire, an aged plug and a wrong switch, all pointing to a shock symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步，想想哪些故障会让人触电。

shots.scene: 阶梯第五级：风险表红色区域加上盾牌后变绿
shots.prompt_en: Step five on the staircase: a risk gauge in the red zone turns green after a shield icon is added. No people.
shots.narration: 第五步，风险太高，就加措施再评估。

shots.section_title: 管理措施比单靠防护有效
shots.scene: 倒三角控制层级图，管理措施一层亮起
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle of five control levels with the administrative controls level glowing, above the protective equipment level. No people.
shots.narration: 控制措施有层级，管理措施比单靠防护有效。
overlay: 管理措施比单靠防护有效

shots.scene: 王老师给大家讲用电安全，大家记笔记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches electrical safety to the young male student and the female graduate student, who take notes.
shots.narration: 一是培训：人人懂危害，会安全操作。

shots.scene: 配电间门口的当心触电标志和仅限授权人员图标
shots.prompt_en: An electrical hazard warning sign and an authorized-personnel-only icon on an electrical room door. No people.
shots.narration: 二是标识：提醒危险，提示怎么做。

shots.scene: 仪器旁贴着空白的操作规程卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank step-by-step procedure card posted beside a lab instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 三是操作规程，最重要。

shots.scene: 小研对照规程卡一步步操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows the posted blank procedure card step by step at the instrument.
shots.narration: 一步一步写清楚，谁来做都一样安全。

shots.section_title: 规定要执行，不能放一边
shots.scene: 规范文本被丢在角落积灰，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank rule booklet left dusty in a corner, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 规定写了不执行，等于没有。
overlay: 规定要执行，不能放一边

shots.section_title: 接触电气设备的人都要培训
shots.scene: 装、修、维护、靠近四个图标都连到培训证书
shots.prompt_en: Four icons for installing, repairing, maintaining and working nearby, each linked to a blank training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 安装、维修、维护或在旁边工作，都要培训。
overlay: 接触电气设备的人都要培训

shots.section_title: 电气测试不戴金属饰物
shots.scene: 戒指、手表、金属手链图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ring, a wristwatch and a metal bracelet crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 电气测试时，不戴戒指手表等金属饰物。
overlay: 电气测试不戴金属饰物

shots.section_title: 规范管设计，也管干活的人
shots.scene: 图纸上的电路和戴安全帽的电工图标
shots.prompt_en: A blueprint with circuit lines next to an electrician icon with a hard hat. No people.
shots.narration: 规范既管系统设计，也管装修人员。
overlay: 规范管设计，也管干活的人

shots.scene: 行业标准书推动规范文本
shots.prompt_en: A blank industry standard book with an arrow pushing into a blank regulation booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 行业标准走在前面，推动了规范完善。

shots.section_title: 测试按标准，电弧要评估
shots.scene: 老李用万用表按规程测量，旁边电弧图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures with a multimeter following a blank procedure card; an arc flash icon is blocked by a shield beside him.
shots.narration: 电气测试按标准做，事先评估电弧风险。
overlay: 测试按标准，电弧要评估

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白评估表上填写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank risk assessment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 评估不能只在脑子里，要写成书面。

shots.scene: 老周签字，王老师盖章
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs the blank form and the safety administrator stamps it.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人审核，高风险报学院审批。

shots.scene: 新设备、新人、方案改动、事故四个图标连到循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Four icons, a new instrument, a new person, an edited plan and a warning flash, each linked to a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 换设备、来新人、改方案、出事后，

shots.scene: 评估表上旧日期划掉，写上新日期
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form with an old date crossed out and a new blank date box. No people.
shots.narration: 都要重新评估，及时更新。

shots.scene: 小研向阿杰讲解评估表，阿杰签字确认
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student explains the blank assessment form to the young male student, who signs to confirm.
shots.narration: 评估结果讲给每个参与的人，签字确认。

shots.section_title: 自制改装用电装置先评估
shots.scene: 自制加热装置和改装电源图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a homemade heating setup and a modified power supply with exposed wiring, under a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 自制或改装的用电装置，风险最难估。
overlay: 自制改装用电装置先评估

shots.section_title: 自制改装用电装置先评估
shots.scene: 老李检查阿杰的旧设备，贴上空白合格标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the young male student's old heating device and attaches a blank passed label.
shots.narration: 先评估、经检查批准，再通电使用。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a five-step staircase icon.
shots.narration: 五步评估：找危害，估风险，加措施。

shots.scene: 培训、标识、规程三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a classroom, a warning sign and a procedure card. No people.
shots.narration: 培训、标识、规程，规定要执行。

shots.scene: 评估表、审批章、循环箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank assessment form, an approval stamp and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 写下来、经审批、常更新、人人知。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着盖好章的评估表挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a stamped blank assessment form and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 先评估再动手，平安实验，下次见！
